extra.message: The unauthenticated 404 handler interpolates request.path into template source passed to render_template_string(). An attacker can put Jinja expressions in a nonexistent URL to execute server-side template code, access application secrets, and potentially execute operating-system commands.

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

extra.message: The global before_request handler passes the attacker-controlled preferences cookie through base64 decoding directly into pickle.loads(). No signature or authentication is checked. A malicious pickle can execute arbitrary Python code before route authentication.

cwe: CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data

extra.message: Flask uses the hardcoded secret key 'super secret key' to sign session cookies. Anyone knowing this value can forge a session containing another user's Flask-Login user ID; routes/login.py loads that user solely by ID, allowing administrator impersonation.

cwe: CWE-321: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key

extra.message: The search query parameter is interpolated directly into a SQL LIKE expression through sqlalchemy.text(). An authenticated attacker can alter the WHERE clause to bypass the current-user restriction and retrieve other users' private notes or extract database data.

cwe: CWE-89: SQL Injection

extra.message: The unauthenticated signup handler passes registration_code into this interpolated SQL statement without parameter binding. Attackers can inject SQL expressions and extract database information through the different no-result and code-mismatch responses. The subsequent token.code comparison does not prevent injection because the SQL has already executed.

cwe: CWE-89: SQL Injection

extra.message: AccountForm exposes an is_admin BooleanField, and all non-null form fields except password are copied directly into current_user.__dict__ and persisted. A regular user can POST is_admin=true to /account to become an administrator. Hiding the checkbox in the template does not enforce authorization.

cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: GET /accounts/<user_id>/notes selects every note belonging to the URL-supplied user ID without comparing it with current_user.id or checking note privacy. Any authenticated user can enumerate other users' IDs and read their private notes.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: POST /notes/<note_id>/delete fetches and deletes the supplied note without checking ownership or administrator status. Any authenticated user can delete another user's public or private notes. The ownership check on the template's delete button does not protect this endpoint.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: POST /account/image passes the submitted URL directly to urlopen(). ImageForm only checks that the value is present; no destination restrictions are applied. An authenticated attacker can request loopback, private-network, or metadata endpoints and retrieve the response from the stored base64 profile image.

cwe: CWE-918: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)

extra.message: The profile-image downloader accepts unrestricted URL schemes, including file://. An authenticated user can supply an absolute local-file URL to read files accessible to the application process. The bytes are base64-encoded, stored on the user's profile, and exposed in the account page's object data attribute.

cwe: CWE-73: External Control of File Name or Path

extra.message: POST /notes stores attacker-supplied text without HTML sanitization, and this template renders it with the safe filter. A public note containing script or event-handler markup executes in other users' application origin when they visit /home. templates/personal_notes.html:16 and templates/search.html:18 also disable escaping for note text.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: The account update accepts ordinary form submissions using wtforms.Form without CSRF tokens or Origin validation, and the application installs no global CSRF protection. Forged requests carrying a victim's session can change their email and password. Note creation/deletion, image updates, registration-code creation, and login likewise lack CSRF checks; GET /logout also changes session state.

cwe: CWE-352: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)

extra.message: Changing a password requires only that the submitted password differ from the submitted password_control value. Both values are client-controlled, and the existing password is never verified. Someone with temporary access to an authenticated session can set a new password and retain control of the account.

cwe: CWE-620: Unverified Password Change

extra.message: Session restoration loads a user solely by the stable database ID. The password-change handler only updates the password hash and does not revoke sessions or rotate a session identifier. A previously stolen session cookie therefore remains authenticated after the victim changes their password.

cwe: CWE-613: Insufficient Session Expiration

extra.message: The login endpoint permits repeated password verification without rate limiting, failed-attempt tracking, delay, or account lockout. No application middleware or supplied nginx configuration limits authentication attempts, allowing online password guessing and credential stuffing.

cwe: CWE-307: Improper Restriction of Excessive Authentication Attempts

extra.message: setup_db(), called during application startup, creates user@evfa.com with password 'user' and admin@evfa.com with password 'admin' when the user table is empty. These documented demo credentials authenticate against the running application and grant administrator access until changed.

cwe: CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials

extra.message: Startup inserts the public, hardcoded registration token a36e990b-0024-4d55-b74a-f8d7528e1764 whenever the registration-code table is empty. Anyone knowing this demo token can satisfy the invitation requirement while it remains available; restarting with an empty code table restores it.

cwe: CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials

extra.message: SQLAlchemy echo=True logs SQL statements and their bound parameters. Application inserts and updates consequently expose private note contents, email addresses, password hashes, and registration tokens to logs.

cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

extra.message: The attacker-selected image URL is fetched without an explicit timeout and read completely into memory without a response-size limit. An authenticated attacker can supply a slow, infinite, or oversized response to occupy workers or exhaust memory. Subsequent base64 encoding allocates additional memory, and successful downloads are persisted to the database.

cwe: CWE-400: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption

extra.message: CSV export copies user-controlled note titles and text into cells and only escapes double quotes. It does not neutralize formula prefixes such as '='. An attacker can place a spreadsheet formula in a note and induce another user to export that user's notes page; opening the CSV in a spreadsheet can evaluate the formula.

cwe: CWE-1236: Improper Neutralization of Formula Elements in a CSV File

extra.message: The supplied nginx deployment serves the application exclusively over HTTP on port 80, exposed as port 5000 by docker-compose.yml, without TLS or an HTTPS redirect. When accessed over a network using this configuration, login passwords, registration tokens, session cookies, and private notes travel in cleartext.

cwe: CWE-319: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information

extra.message: The application initializes Flask sessions and Flask-Login without setting SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE, leaving Flask's default false value. Authentication cookies can therefore be transmitted over HTTP, including through the supplied HTTP deployment, exposing sessions to network interception.

cwe: CWE-614: Sensitive Cookie in HTTPS Session Without 'Secure' Attribute
